text:
mattg: heads up - seeing a sharp preemptible churn in us-west1-a since ~12:05 UTC, ~28% of preempt GPU nodes evicted in 6m, text-gen p99 latency up 450ms and error retries spiking.

capacity-bot: [ALERT] Preemptible termination event detected: zone=us-west1-a, impacted_nodes=132, event_window=00:06:00

sara-eng: ugh. is this the auction spike again? any network flaps reported?

neil-ops: I'm pulling instance termination logs. Cloud provider shows a localized maintenance signal + spot-price blip. No reported AZ-wide network outage, looks like aggressive preempt policy on fraction of machines.

jenna-sre: @mattg can you confirm which pools are most hit (mixed vs pure-spot)?

mattg: mixed-gpu-pool-1 is the worst (mixed cpu/gpu preemptible heavy); dedicated-ondemand pools unaffected. Affected shards: gen-inference-route-03 and 04.

simon-ml: that explains KV cache misses - those routes had high prefix caching. When nodes vanished we saw KV shards remap -> cache warmup + backpressure.

jenna-sre: action plan I propose: 1) route traffic away from gen-inference-route-03/04 to healthy routes (canary->route-05/ondemand) 2) temporarily disable aggressive downscale for mixed pools 3) warm up a small on-demand burst in us-west1 to absorb load 4) reduce default batch size for gen endpoints to lower p99.

mattg: +1. I'll patch routing weight. Doing `curl -X POST https://router.internal/weights -d '{"route":"gen-inference-route-03","weight":0.0}'`

deploy-bot: deployment mattg/route-weight-change succeeded for gen-inference-route-03 at 12:13 UTC

sara-eng: @neil-ops can you flip autoscaler policy to keep min_replicas up while we stabilize?

neil-ops: on it. current autoscale config for mixed-gpu-pool-1: ```min_replicas: 8
max_replicas: 120
cooldown_down: 300s
cooldown_up: 60s
spot_preempt_sensitivity: normal
```

neil-ops: increasing min_replicas -> 16 and cooldown_down -> 900s to avoid immediate scale-down after evictions. Applying now.

capacity-bot: Autoscaler config updated: pool=mixed-gpu-pool-1, min_replicas=16, cooldown_down=900s

simon-ml: I'll trigger two ondemand warm nodes in us-west1 (g4dn equivalent) and pre-pull models. This will cost but needed short-term.

mattg: estimate cost delta for 2x ondemand GPUs ~ +$3.2/hr. Approve?

sara-eng: fine to approve for 2 hours. Post-incident we can decide if we need a short-term reserved commit.

jenna-sre: also lower gen endpoint batch_size: from 32 -> 12 for route-05 and route-backups. Quick patch: ```PATCH /api/config/routes/gen-inference
{ "defaults": { "batch_size": 12, "timeout_ms": 12000 } }
```

deploy-bot: config patch applied to gen-inference (route-05 and backups) at 12:16 UTC

mattg: traffic shifted, routing weights show 90% -> route-05/ondemand, 10% -> route-02 (low capacity). p99 latency dropping toward baseline but still ~+120ms.

sara-eng: checking error logs for downstream clients - a few retry storms from mobile clients, but mostly recovered. We should add a short-term client-side retry jitter to avoid thundering.

neil-ops: provider reported completion of maintenance signal in us-west1-a at 12:24 UTC, but terminations already happened. We'll keep watch for additional waves.

jenna-sre: tagging incident as partial-az-preempt-burst. Can someone own postmortem notes? Key items: mixed pool placement strategy, cache shard remapping during node loss, autoscaler cooldown tuning, warm-on-demand playbook, cost/commit decision.

simon-ml: I'll capture model warming checklist and cache prefetch heuristics.

mattg: I'll write ops timeline and include graphs (p99, spot-termination-rate, routing weights).

sara-eng: neil, can you add a runbook entry that if preemptible churn >20% in 10m, we auto-increase min_replicas and trigger on-demand warmers? Keep cost cap logic too.

neil-ops: adding runbook snippet now: ```if spot_churn_rate(zone) > 0.2 over 10m:
  set_pool_min_replicas(mixed, 2x baseline)
  spawn_on_demand_nodes(zone, N=ceil(0.02*baseline_gpus))
  notify #eng-infra
```

capacity-bot: Monitoring alert cleared for ongoing terminations in us-west1-a at 12:35 UTC

mattg: p99 back to ~+30ms above baseline, errors dropped. We'll keep the mixed pool min_replicas high for 45m then reassess.

sara-eng: for cost discussion: if this pattern repeats freq > 3/month we should evaluate small reserved commitment for us-west1 to pin baseline capacity; compute team: estimate 3-month cost/benefit.

jenna-sre: assigning follow-ups: mattg (timeline + graphs), simon-ml (cache warming doc), neil-ops (runbook + autoscale defaults), sara-eng (cost analysis). I'll create a postmortem in postmortems/ after we collect data.

mattg: thanks all. Great quick moves. Closing thread - keep monitoring for any aftershocks. :white_check_mark:
